title: settings translations: a columns group so a map setting's key and column headers translate (item 7 of #31391)
body:
domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jVEjiYrK7onirxUGyo

carries item 7 of #31391; #31391 keeps items 1–6 and 8 (PR #31451).

Filing gate: **④ coordination child**, the spec layer of #31391 item 7, under #30208 row 5 (ruling record 6715997428, option A).
Business reason: an administrator using Setup in Chinese (or any non-English locale) sees Data Lifecycle's map tables headed in English (`Object`, `Keep rows for`, `Expire rows after`, `Max rows`, `Lifecycle class`) beside translated labels and help text. Until this lands, those five headers cannot be translated by any bundle.
Reader: a `domain:spec` seat first (the translation schema), then the `domain:ui` seat (the console reads the new group; a small follow-up in `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsMapField.tsx`).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `map specifier columns translation`, `keyColumn label translation` → #31391 and #30208 only; none is this group.
reach: Setup → Data Lifecycle in any non-English locale, once PR #31451 draws the map tables (the headers render `keyColumn.label` / `columns[].label` as served).

## 维护者速读

数据生命周期的三张 map 表（保留期覆盖、行数配额、按类默认配额）表头是英文字面量，现在没有地方可以翻译。要在设置的翻译结构里给每个键加一个 `columns` 分组（键列 + 各值列的标签），控制台再读它。存储与保存门不变。

## Readings (`origin/main` `216b18a6c`)

- The literals: `packages/objectql/src/lifecycle/lifecycle-settings.ts` ~L51–80 (`keyColumn: { label: 'Object' }`, `{ name: 'maxAge', label: 'Keep rows for' }`, `{ name: 'expireAfter', label: 'Expire rows after' }`, `{ name: 'max_rows', label: 'Max rows' }`, `keyColumn: { label: 'Lifecycle class' }`).
- The settings `keys.<key>` translation entry in `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` has no `columns` group (the card #31391 body, item 7: "Translating them needs a `columns` group in the settings `keys.<key>` translation entry … and ui's copies of that schema").
- PR #31451 renders the headers through `pickLocalized`, so an inline locale map would already show; a bundle-keyed group is what is missing.

## Expected

1. Spec: the settings `keys.<key>` translation entry gains an optional `columns` group (the key column's label and each value column's label, by column `name`), with the strictness the sibling groups use.
2. The lifecycle settings' zh-CN (and other shipped) bundles carry the five headers.
3. Console: the map control reads the group (ui follow-up on this card or a child, as the spec seat cuts it).

Refs #31391, #30208
